video_title: Neemias Queta: "Sometimes I Don't Think I'm Aggressive Enough" | Celtics Pregame

quotes.speaker: Neemias Queta
quotes.summary_phrase: Neemias Queta on his evolving offensive role with the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: I think it's just a little bit more added responsibility, added trust.
quotes.quote: I think it's just a little bit more added responsibility, added trust. Obviously, as the years go by, I think I'm also entering my prime, so I'm becoming more comfortable out there. It's just a combination of those things. Whether I start the game making the first couple shots or I'm setting the screens, I'm cool with that.
quotes.social_post: Neemias Queta says he is feeling more comfortable and settled into his role with the Celtics this season as he enters his prime.

structured.context: Neemias Queta discusses his evolving role and increased responsibility with the Celtics.

quotes.speaker: Neemias Queta
quotes.summary_phrase: Neemias Queta on balancing aggression and team play
quotes.excerpt: Sometimes I don't think I'm aggressive enough, so it's a balance that you got to be able to have.
quotes.quote: Obviously I trust my offense a lot, but sometimes I don't think I'm aggressive enough, so it's a balance that you got to be able to have. I think I'm able to toe the line without overdoing it, so I like where I'm at.
quotes.social_post: Neemias Queta admits he is still working on his offensive mindset saying sometimes I do not think I am aggressive enough.

structured.context: Neemias Queta reflects on finding the right balance between playing aggressively and maintaining team play.

quotes.speaker: Neemias Queta
quotes.summary_phrase: Neemias Queta on the importance of the center position
quotes.excerpt: The most efficient shots are at the rim, so a lot of those on offense and defense they got to go through you.
quotes.quote: Obviously I'm a center, so I'm a little bit biased, but just the amount of responsibility that you have. The most efficient shots are at the rim, so a lot of those on offense and defense they got to go through you. Being able to create as many easy looks at the rim offensively, whether it's through screening, whether it's me getting the dump downs, or being able to be an offensive rebounding guy and make those shots, and then defensively deterring people from getting out there, I think that impacts a lot of the game.
quotes.social_post: Neemias Queta breaks down the importance of the center position and why he believes the game flows through the paint on both ends of the floor.

structured.context: Neemias Queta explains the importance and responsibilities of the center position in the modern game.

quotes.speaker: Neemias Queta
quotes.summary_phrase: Neemias Queta on his growth and development this season
quotes.excerpt: Whatever I did last year doesn't even matter anymore, so I'm just trying to build off of this season.
quotes.quote: Obviously this year is a new season. Whatever I did last year doesn't even matter anymore, so I'm just trying to build off of this season and keep on growing off the previous game. If I can have this year be like last year's ceiling be my this year's floor, I think I'm in a good spot.
quotes.social_post: Neemias Queta on his development goals for the season: If I can have this year be like last year's ceiling be my this year's floor I think I am in a good spot.

structured.context: Neemias Queta discusses his personal growth and development goals for the current season.

quotes.speaker: Neemias Queta
quotes.summary_phrase: Neemias Queta on his two-man game with Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: It's really effective, being able to get open pull-up threes, being able to put both of us under pressure.
quotes.quote: It's really effective, being able to get open pull-up threes, being able to put both of us under pressure on the rim, getting easy looks at the rim. I think we're both able to get rebounds off each other, so it's a good connection that we have and I think we can only get better as the year goes by.
quotes.social_post: Neemias Queta says his two man game with Jayson Tatum is becoming really effective and believes their connection will only get better as the season goes on.

structured.context: Neemias Queta describes the effectiveness of his two-man game partnership with Jayson Tatum.
